name: ai.stdapi/stdapi-ai
title: stdapi.ai
description: Self-hosted MCP tools for Amazon Bedrock and the AWS AI services, in your own AWS account.

environmentVariables.name: ENABLE_MCP_STREAMABLE_HTTP
environmentVariables.description: Serve the MCP endpoint at /mcp. Off by default: without it the container starts and serves its REST APIs, but exposes no MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_REGION
environmentVariables.description: AWS region the gateway calls Amazon Bedrock and the AWS AI services in.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Access key of an AWS principal allowed to call the services you enable. Omit when the container already receives credentials from its task or instance role.

environmentVariables.name: AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Session token, when the credentials above are temporary.

environmentVariables.name: API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Require this bearer token on every request. Strongly recommended: without it the endpoint is unauthenticated to anything that can reach the port.
